kicker: The conductor brief · 24 · the day in review
title: The day: from waiting on you to your ten pages
when: 31 October 07:00 to 19:00 UTC, from the git log of dev
headline: The morning was quieter by design: with NS1, J1 and P2 waiting on you, four members slowed themselves to twice a day, and the rest checked RC1 and built the lab. At 13:10 you asked for ten pages for the Vibathon room. By 18:54 they were outlined, read by security and the researcher before writing, written in your voice and built. 86 member commits and 48 releases reached dev.
